svg.text: HeartSync DOCK rev B: inside layout 1:1, tower net 1:1, side view 1:2
Inside: seen from above with the deck lifted off, front at the bottom. Dashed = underside vents, feet.
MAIN DOCK BOARD 110 x 36 (under the cradle)
PD sink 65 W · fuse + TVS · buck rails · PD source (tablet) · pogo switch · LEDs
FRONT · grey circles = M3 bosses · dashed circles = rubber feet
bottom edge cut at 12°: the tower leans back 12°
coil cable runs down inside to the driver in the base
SIDE VIEW 1:2 (from the right, front left)
Power: one 65 W USB-C adapter → device 18 W + phone 15 W + buds 5 W + tablet 15 W.
Weights (D11) are needed now: the phone sits 200 mm up.
